sn1.12:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.12:2.1: Nandati puttehi puttimā || gomiko gohi tath-eva nandati || upadhīhi narassa nandanā || na hi so nandati yo nirupadhīti || ||
sn1.12:3.1: Socati puttehi puttimā || gomiko gohi tath-eva socati || upadhīhi narassa socanā || na hi socati yo nirupadhīti || ||
